name: get_order_details
description: One of the customer's orders in full: items and quantities, prices, pickup branch or delivery address, prescription review result and the pharmacist's note, payment, delivery progress, whether it can still be cancelled. No order given = their latest order.

order_ref.description: The order number the customer wrote, e.g. S00046.

returns.description: order_ref, status, items, total_sar, fulfillment, branch, delivery_address, prescription_review, pharmacist_note, payment, delivery_progress, cold_chain, can_cancel.

errors.when: no such order for this customer
